_model: Window proc. 0x1004CE94 -> node cur, cur+4 -> window, window+0x1c -> widget nodes n1 (w1 button), n2 (w2 list box, items i1..i3), n3 (w3 scroll bar, thumb size at @thumb). PtInRect is stubbed: its per-call returns pick which rects are hit. lParam = y << 16 | x (top of every list rect is 100).
